summary: This is a routine press release regarding Mobilicom's participation in the Modern Day Marine 2026 trade show, filed as a Form 6-K by the foreign private issuer. It announces the company will exhibit its cybersecure drone and robotics solutions at the event and hold meetings with U.S. Department of War and Marine Corps representatives. No financial terms, transaction structure, board recommendations, advisors, or special-situation mechanics are mentioned. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situations event. It is solely an operational update.
